observations: All 153 one-second samples and all 18 transition samples were inspected on contact sheets. All 10 scene samples were inspected at their actual 1080 × 1920 resolution.
The browser area is briefly blank or loading at the start, then shows the full viewport. There is no screenshot-induced gray region or narrowed viewport.

After import, Aurora shows Receipt unmatched, a GBP 2,000 cash shortfall and a legal blocker. After the match, GBP 50,500 reconciles and the legal blocker remains visible before the main narration starts.
The import dialog scrolls during its scene to show the validation diff and Import validated changes action.
The legal, human review and packet dialogs fit within the recorded desktop viewport, with their final actions visible.
Human review shows revision 5, its hash and attestation. The reviewed packet shows revision 6, its hash and downloads. Reloading preserves the approved current revision.
The local demonstration and synthetic data label, and the sole public credit to Ayo Ahmed, remain clear throughout the sampled timeline.

The entire 1440 × 900 source frame, with square pixels, maps to 1080 × 675 at y = 575. All 10 matching-timestamp pixel comparisons have mean RGB differences below 4 of 255, consistent with lossy encoding and resizing.
Headings and captions fit the portrait canvas. The sampled transitions show clean heading changes. Caption and voice interval checks find no overlaps.
